owner_message_english_translation: I looked and I like the stone. You can clean up the previous lobby levels; we do not need them. Keep only the current one, and let us start the next materials on the level.
decision: Accept the corrected stone material direction; remove obsolete lobby maps and continue material authoring on the current map.
supersedes: Historical requirements to keep obsolete lobby maps in Content and to duplicate the current level for every material candidate.
preservation: Keep approved stone bytes, current architecture and owner edits; preserve source/reference/review history and exact retired-map recovery mapping outside Content.
not_granted: Whole-lobby materials, final architecture/detail, glass, atmosphere or performance acceptance.
